en: Colorized panoramic view of a valley town surrounded by steep green mountains and distant snowy peaks. The settlement has many white buildings with red roofs and a prominent church with a tall bell tower in the center. In the foreground are patchwork agricultural fields. Handwritten-style captions on the sky area read the town name on the left and the mountain name and height on the right. A small date is written near the town name.
